name: Gakuyou Kanja no Chou-shuuchi Taiken
original_name: 学用患者の超羞恥体験
source:
A girl hospitalized as a Scholastic Use Patient.
Resistance is not an option... under the guise of 'training' and
'research' she will be played mischief upon and humiliated!
